subject: qcaucd compact global resource type 0x1d in the MicArray DMIC path
correction: The earlier identification of qcaucd compact type 0x1d as qcpep RPMH_COMMIT was invalid. The two drivers use distinct resource enums; numeric equality alone did not establish identity.

qcpep_disproof.reason_not_equivalent: qcpep PEP resource-code enum and qcaucd compact AUCD resource enum are distinct domains

conclusion: For the MicArray path, qcaucd compact type 0x1d value 8 is consumed as DMIC clock-selector input and selects selector 2, corresponding to TX-macro DIV4. The original symbolic name of qcaucd compact type 0x1d remains unknown.
